name: @alanwalton/native-shell
description: iOS Capacitor shell (thin WKWebView over the live alanwalton.com site) + offline-audio native seam. Built on the macbook via Xcode.

scripts.ios:add: bash scripts/write-capacitor-config.sh && cap add ios && bash scripts/apply-ios-seam.sh
scripts.ios:sync: bash scripts/write-capacitor-config.sh && cap sync ios && bash scripts/apply-ios-seam.sh
